messages:
lee: quick heads-up, onboarding cust-ares LoRA onto oak-13b-v2.1. Quick-eval shows a vocab reshuffle causing token splits and an int4 quality regression.
toni: what do you mean by 'vocab reshuffle'?
lee: their tokenizer inserts <SER> and <CURR> and reassigns ~8 high ids. Naive adapter splice left some currency/punct tokens split across multiple sub-tokens.
sam: any runtime breakage?
lee: saw this when streaming batched requests:
```
Error: kv_cache length mismatch (expected 20, got 16)
  at runtime/kv_cache.cc:198
```
Turns out model.config.max_position_embeddings was still 4096 while we tested ~7k contexts. Bumped to 8192 locally, resolved.
toni: numbers from the quick pack?
lee: invoice/amount extraction quick-eval: 
- oak-13b fp16 (baseline): EM=0.85 F1=0.92
- cust-ares-lora fp16: EM=0.83 F1=0.90
- cust-ares-lora int4 (naive): EM=0.75 F1=0.86
Quantization is the largest delta here (8-10 pts EM).
ana: can you paste a failing sample?
lee: sample:
```
input: "Subtotal: $3,210.00 (incl. 8% tax)"
baseline: "Subtotal: $3,210.00 (incl. 8% tax)"
merged-fp16: "Subtotal: $3,210.00 (incl. 8% tax)"
merged-int4: "Subtotal 3210.00 included eight percent tax"
```
Note removed punctuation and $ split into [63,4007].
sam: run token_diff and paste minimal output.
lee: token_diff snippet: `$ => base:[2505] candidate:[63,4007] ; "%" => base:[3012] candidate:[3012]` so % is fine but $ got split.
qc-bot: quick-eval flagged token-drift: token id split for $ occurs in 0.37% of samples > threshold 0.1%.
toni: remediation options?
lee: three paths: (A) reindex LoRA and remap embedding rows (accurate but needs weight resave), (B) add a preprocess collapse map for known split pairs (fast), (C) keep base tokenizer and re-align LoRA during merge with explicit id mapping.
sam: also try per-channel quant with bias correction and a short QAT on LoRA params.
lee: kicked off quant_sim: `scripts/quant_sim.py --model merged/cust-ares --method perchannel --calib 800` and a light QAT sim: `scripts/qat_sim.py --model merged/cust-ares --steps 600 --lr 5e-6`.
qc-bot: quant_sim uploaded: /artifacts/ares/1766601234/quant_sim.json. per-channel symmetric int4 EM delta -0.09; asymmetric -0.05; QAT sim predicts -0.03.
toni: rollout recommendation?
sam: propose canary merged-fp16 at 3% on dedicated pool; hold int4 until QAT or reindex yields EM within 0.03 of baseline.
lee: implemented a preprocess normalization that collapses known token pairs (e.g., [63,4007] -> $) before detokenize; reran int4 quickpack -> EM improved 0.75 -> 0.78. Partial win.
toni: good incremental. Add token-diff check into quick-eval CI and a preflight rule rejecting merges with >0.1% splits for high-frequency tokens like $.
lee: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/customer-onboards/issues/4367 with diffs, token-dumps, failing samples, and suggested fixes.
deploy-bot: Canary started: ares-lora-fp16 -> dedicated/pool-11 (3%). Fallback rule: EM_drop >= 0.035 over sliding window of 1k -> revert to oak-13b.
qc-bot: added token-drift rule to quick-eval (threshold 0.1%).
sam: actions: (1) lee: iterate on token-aligned remerge or reindex LoRA; (2) sam: run QAT / full remerge experiments; (3) toni: monitor canary + alert. Reopen thread when artifacts ready. thx :thumbsup:
